Former ISRO Scientist Appointed Head of Tamil Nadu Curriculum Panel

Mylswamy Annadurai, a former scientist from ISRO, has been appointed as the chairman of the reconstituted curriculum design panel for Tamil Nadu. The government order specifies that the committee will serve for a tenure of three years. This appointment is related to the overhaul of the state board syllabus.
